nes, & non retentum merum ac solum S. scripturae

page.notes: Marginal note "fu" at bottom is a catchword. Some words in the italic passage are doubtful, especially "ex solo", "hac illud suum" and "quum" readings; the Hebrew phrase after "anathema" is printed as Hebrew letters, transcribed approximately; "eo t.lxv i i." is an uncertain reading of a marginal reference inside the text.
